description.value: JAPADOG is an award-winning, iconic Vancouver hot dog concept founded in 2005 that blends Japanese flavours and ingredients with the classic North American hot dog. The McArthurGlen Outlet Mall location serves the full menu of specialty dogs featuring Kurobuta pork, Wagyu beef, and authentic Japanese sauces alongside veggie and vegan options. It has become a sought-after culinary stop for locals and tourists alike, drawing celebrity attention and international recognition for its unique fusion approach.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the McArthurGlen Outlet Mall location at 7899 Templeton Station Road, Richmond matches the OSM address exactly. Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('We are open for Takeout, Delivery & Curbside Service + Dine-in'). The menu page lists a dedicated 'VEGGIE HOT DOGS' section including explicitly vegan options (Vegan Avocado & Cheez, Vegan Tomato & Cheez), confirming vegetarian/vegan availability. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other amenities was found in the website content.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM record and none found for this specific location on the website.
Website is the corporate multi-location site; no location-specific page or direct contact for the Richmond outlet is available.
Washroom availability is unconfirmed — this is an outlet mall location where public washrooms would typically be nearby but are not documented in available evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: JAPADOG is a well-established, actively operating iconic food destination in Richmond near the YVR airport cycling corridor, offering takeout and vegan/vegetarian options that make it a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website menu lists a dedicated 'VEGGIE HOT DOGS' section including explicitly vegan items: Vegan Avocado & Cheez, Vegan Tomato & Cheez, plus multiple other veggie options
